text:
Predicates:
Symptom(x) ::: x is a symptom of Monkeypox.
Include(y, x) ::: y is included in the list of symptoms x.
Coughing(x) ::: x is coughing.
Monkeypox(x) ::: x is Monkeypox.
Virus(x) ::: x is the monkeypox virus.
OccurIn(y, x) ::: y can occur in x.
Animal(x) ::: x is an animal.
Human(x) ::: x is a human.
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
FeelingTired(x) ::: x feels tired.
Get(x, y) ::: x gets y.
Glu(x) ::: x gets glu.
People(x) ::: x are people.
SymptomsInclude(x, y) ::: symptoms of x include y.

Premises:
Monkeypox(x) → Virus(x) ::: Monkeypox is caused by a virus.
Virus(x) ∧ OccurIn(y, x) ∧ (Animal(y) ∨ Human(y)) ::: Monkeypox virus can occur in animals and humans.
Human(x) ∧ Mammal(x) ::: Humans are mammals.
Mammal(x) ∧ Animal(x) ::: Mammals are animals.
SymptomsInclude(Monkeypox, fever) ∧ SymptomsInclude(Monkeypox, headache) ∧ SymptomsInclude(Monkeypox, muscle pains) ∧ SymptomsInclude(Monkeypox, feeling tired) ::: Symptoms of Monkeypox include fever, headache, muscle pains, feeling tired.
FeelingTired(z) ∧ Get(z, glu) ::: People feel tired when they get a glu.

Conclusion:
Symptom(Monkeypox) ∧ Coughing(coughing) ::: Symptoms of Monkeypox include coughing.
